title: Self-Pay Take-Home Kit Price — Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing)
content:
**Kit price term.** When take-home convenience items billed under revenue code 0274 on an Outpatient Surgery Account of the Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) are valued for an Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing), the take-home kit share multiplies the whole convenience value:

| Convenience codes billed on the account (cold-therapy unit E0218, cold pack A9273, support garment A4467) | Kit share |
|---|---|
| all three (Riverbend's self-pay kit price) | 0.8 |
| exactly two | 0.9 |
| otherwise (one code) | 1 |


Example (hypothetical): items valued at 200.00 in total, with all three codes billed → 160.00; with two codes billed → 180.00.
